requirements.title: Software hazard control verified by Analysis
requirements.description: The safety manager shall place the PA enable line low within 2 ms of a watchdog reset.
requirements.rationale: Self-derived: SWE-134 a provision. A software hazard control with method Analysis is seeded on purpose: SWE-192 admits no Analysis exception for SW modules (V&V 7.3 rule 6).
requirements.verification_note: Analysis accepted per RSK-001: timing analysis of the reset path.
